question:

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  q.XCL_062
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d
  ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races AS r
  ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
WHERE
  d.XCL_035 = 'Bruno'
  AND d.XCL_038 = 'Senna'
  AND r.XCL_065 = 354
